name: TrendsAGI
description: Live trend intelligence for AI agents: measured trend volume, velocity and growth, AI trend insights, recommendations, crisis events and read-only SQL over the signed-in user's TrendsAGI account.
author: TrendsAGI

tools.description: List topics trending now on social platforms with measured volume, velocity and growth. Use to find what is rising in a category or around a brand, product or competitor; sort_by=velocity returns the fastest-accelerating topics first. Filter by category (see list_trend_categories) or a search phrase. Covers the last 24 hours unless period says otherwise. Returns at most 25 trends.

category.description: Category name, e.g. 'Technology'. Use list_trend_categories for valid names.

period.description: Lookback window. Defaults to 24h so results are current; use 7d or 30d for a brand or niche phrase with less activity.

search.description: Only return trends whose name matches this phrase, e.g. a brand, product or competitor.

sort_by.description: velocity = fastest accelerating; volume = biggest audience right now.

tools.name: list_trends
tools.title: List trending topics

tools.description: List the trend category names that list_trends accepts.
tools.name: list_trend_categories
tools.title: List trend categories

tools.description: Search AI-generated trend insights by theme, e.g. 'AI chips' or 'sustainable packaging', and return the matching trends. Use when the user describes a topic or product rather than naming a trend. Requires a plan with insight search.

query.description: Theme or phrase to search for.

tools.name: search_trend_insights
tools.title: Search trend insights

tools.description: Get one trend by id: current volume, velocity, growth and category.

trend_id.description: Numeric trend id from list_trends or search_trend_insights.

tools.name: get_trend
tools.title: Get a trend

tools.description: Get the stored AI insight for one trend: summary, key themes, sentiment, audience and suggested marketing angles. Use for audience, messaging or creative questions about a specific trend. Returns not_found when no insight has been generated yet.

trend_id.description: Numeric trend id from list_trends or search_trend_insights.

tools.name: get_trend_ai_insights
tools.title: Get trend insight

tools.description: Get the source-backed dossier for one trend: what the label resolves to, a dated timeline, evidence coverage, named channels, the content landscape, brands and products. Use when the user asks what a trend is, what happened, where it is being discussed, or what content to publish. Returns not_found when no dossier has been generated yet.

trend_id.description: Numeric trend id from list_trends or search_trend_insights.

tools.name: get_trend_dossier
tools.title: Get trend dossier

tools.description: List labels found in an external trend list, deduplicated and cached. This is discovery evidence, not a TrendsAGI measurement: it has no volume or velocity. Use to catch a label that has not appeared in the measured trend table yet; matched_trend_id points at the measured trend when one already exists.
tools.name: list_web_trends
tools.title: List external web trends

tools.description: Get one trend's volume time series over 24h, 7d or 30d. Use to tell whether a trend is still rising, flat or fading, for example before deciding on campaign timing or budget.

trend_id.description: Numeric trend id from list_trends or search_trend_insights.

tools.name: get_trend_analytics
tools.title: Get trend trajectory

tools.description: List the recommendations TrendsAGI generated for this account (marketing angles, content ideas, SEO actions, PR responses and more), each with a decision brief and its evidence. The confidence score measures evidence completeness, not the probability of success. Requires a plan with recommendations.

match_user_interests.description: Only recommendations for the account's watchlist topics.

tools.name: list_recommendations
tools.title: List recommendations

tools.description: List reputation or crisis events detected for this account's monitored topics. Use when the user asks about risks around a brand or topic. Requires a plan with crisis monitoring.
tools.name: list_crisis_events
tools.title: List crisis events

tools.description: List the topics this account watches, with their alert conditions.
tools.name: list_watchlist
tools.title: List watchlist

tools.description: Get the account's API usage against its daily limit. Use when a tool reports a rate or daily limit.
tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.title: Get API usage

tools.description: List the tables execute_sql can query, with every column's type and meaning, the query rules and example queries. Call once before writing SQL.
tools.name: read_data_schema
tools.title: Read the SQL data schema

tools.description: Run one read-only PostgreSQL SELECT over the account's TrendsAGI data (tables from read_data_schema: trends, trend_snapshots, trend_categories, trend_insights, watchlist, recommendations, crisis_events). Use for questions that need filtering, joins or aggregation. Returns columns and rows; results stop at max_rows.

query.description: One SELECT (WITH ... SELECT is fine), e.g. SELECT name, volume, growth_pct FROM trends WHERE last_seen_at > now() - interval '24 hours' ORDER BY velocity_per_hour DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 20.

tools.name: execute_sql
tools.title: Run a read-only SQL query

tools.description: Check whether TrendsAGI can do a task and how: returns the tools that cover it, or the page in the TrendsAGI app where the user does it. Use when no other tool fits the user's request, for example setting up an alert, exporting data or connecting an ad account. Describe the task in a few words; do not include personal details.

goal.description: The task in a few words, e.g. 'alert me when a topic spikes' or 'export trends to a spreadsheet'.

tools.name: find_capability
tools.title: Find a TrendsAGI capability
